Description:
Creates a VM with LNMP installed:
This template creates a VM with LNMP installed. Prerequisites:
The instance offering, image, and network are created. Make sure that the network can access the Internet, and cloudinit is installed for the image. Otherwise, the VM may fail to be created or the LNMP may not work properly after creation

#cloud-config
users:
 - name: root
   shell: /bin/bash
   groups: root
   sudo: ['ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL']
   ssh-authorized-keys:
       - ssh-rsa  root@10.0.121.175
write_files:
 - path: /tmp/ZStack_config
   content: |
       Hello,world!
hostname: koven-test
disable_root: false
chpasswd:
  list: |
      root:password
  expire: False
runcmd:
 - curl http://soft.vpser.net/lnmp/lnmp1.4.tar.gz -o lnmp1.4.tar.gz && tar zxf lnmp1.4.tar.gz && cd lnmp1.4 && echo ""|./install.sh lnmp
